posts.text: I drove the entire 20 hours while these guys were asleep
I didn’t expect this hackathon to end with me shoving someone into a pool

I realized that I sit on a lot of projects. A year ago today, I made a chrome extension that was literally just chatgpt but with this highlight feature inspired by Google's circle to search. I had completely finished it, and I use it all the time. It's really convenient for simple tasks, so you dont have to switch tabs. After being inspired by some friends, I decided to publish it. It's literally just ChatGPT 4o. (just images, no file uploading). And its COMPLETELY FREE, so use it all you want.

Teaming up with Owen Gretzinger and the Boardy team has been amazing! Boardy is an AI that connects you with CEOs, engineers, and more. Message Boardy to learn about his new fellowship program. Be sure to wish him a happy birthday today too! 🎂
